# NVIDIA Optical Flow API header

`nvOpticalFlowCommon.h` is NVIDIA's public Optical Flow API 5.0 interface
header. It is used only for compile-time declarations; the renderer loads the
driver-provided `nvofapi64.dll` at runtime.

Source: `jp7677/dxvk-nvapi`, commit
`d102231de42d64fe914f99a9a55a66029902cb59`,
`inc/nvofapi/nvOpticalFlowCommon.h`.

The header carries NVIDIA's MIT license notice in the file itself.
